price_units: USD per 1 million tokens, standard tier (not Priority, not Flex/Batch), text input and text output, as printed on https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/pricing. Embedding prices are per 1 million of the page's '1,000 count' unit, online requests.
price_page_date: fetched 2026-09-06; the page shows no last-updated date; HTTP Last-Modified header: not sent by server; dated statements on the page: introductory pricing for Gemini 3.6 Flash runs through December 31, 2026 and standard pricing of 1.50 in and 7.50 out applies from January 1, 2027; non-global endpoint pricing for Gemini 3 and later families applies from July 1, 2026

price_notes.gemini-2.5-pro: Prompts up to 200K input tokens. Above 200K: 2.50 in, 15.00 out.
price_notes.gemini-2.5-flash: Text, image, video input. Audio input is 1.00.
price_notes.gemini-2.5-flash-lite: Text, image, video input. Audio input is 0.30.
price_notes.gemini-embedding-001: Page row 'Gemini Embedding': 0.00015 USD per 1,000 count online, 0.00012 batch, output no charge.
price_notes.text-embedding-005: Page row 'Embeddings for Text (Excluding Gemini Embedding)': 0.000025 USD per 1,000 count online, 0.00002 batch, output no charge. The page prints 'count' as the unit; it does not say tokens or characters.
price_notes.gemini-3.7-flash: Global endpoint price. Introductory through 2026-12-31. From 2027-01-01: 1.50 in, 7.50 out. Read from the pricing page on 2026-09-06 during the proxy verification (proxy-verify.md).
price_notes.gemini-3.8-flash: Global endpoint price. Introductory through 2026-12-31. From 2027-01-01: 1.50 in, 7.50 out. Read from the pricing page on 2026-09-06 during the proxy verification (proxy-verify.md).

probe_date: 2026-09-06 (3.7 and 3.8 added 2026-09-06 after the proxy verification)
chandan_model_note: chandan_model is the survey choice kept for older callers. Design section 13 fixes the calibration row as indexed with gemini-3.7-flash and answered with gemini-3.6-flash (his result-file configuration); those are chandan_index_model and chandan_answer_model. The main chandan rows use chat_model.

thinking_defaults.gemini-2.5-flash: reasoning_effort none set in config.yaml (thinkingBudget 0). A request that sends reasoning_effort overrides it.
thinking_defaults.gemini-2.5-pro: no default; thinks unless the request sends reasoning_effort
thinking_defaults.gemini-3.x: cannot be turned off: Vertex rejects reasoning_effort none (thinking level minimal unsupported). Allow at least 64 output tokens for 3.6 and 3.7 and about 128 for 3.8 before any text appears.

proxy_min_output_tokens_note: Design section 13: every Part 1 call sets an output limit of at least 64 tokens. Measured 2026-09-06 for a one-word answer: 3.6 and 3.7 use 57 to 59 reasoning tokens, 3.8 uses 96 and returns an empty choices list at 64.
job_tag_note: Send a job tag as the OpenAI user field (user= on the python client) or as extra_body={'metadata': {'tags': ['<tag>']}}. requests.jsonl records job_tag, tags and user per row. metadata.tags wins when both are sent.
